verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail advertises a direct API and Zapier integration for connecting mail workflows to other apps, which implies scans/metadata could be exported, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk export feature for PDFs and mail history, and probes for developer docs/OpenAPI specs all returned 404s, casting doubt on how well-documented or usable this API actually is. missing for 10: explicit bulk-export/download-all documentation, confirmation of metadata export format, working API reference (openapi/docs) proving the capability functions as described.
